summary: # Complete Tutorial on Registration, Login, and Trial on the CLO China Official Website This document provides a step-by-step guide for new users to register, log in, and access the trial version of the CLO China official website. ## Accessing the Website First, open our Chinese official website: [3w.clo3d-china.com](http://3w.clo3d-china.com). It is recommended to use a computer to open the website, as mobile phone and WeChat browsers can easily lose the page. We recommend using Chrome or other mainstream browsers for the best experience. ## Registration Process ### Step 1: Logging In 1. Click the **Login** button. 2. On the login page, enter your email, password, and mobile phone number. 3. After receiving the mobile phone verification code, click **Verify**. 4. Click **Create Account** to verify as a real person. ### Step 2: Email Verification Next, check your registered email to receive the verification email. Congratulations! You have successfully registered your account. You can click on the upper right corner of the website to check your account details. ### Step 3: Signing Up for Free Application If you want to sign up for the free application, please click the blue **Free Application** button. Click **Download** to start the free application for 14 days. The latest version of the software will automatically be downloaded. ### Step 4: Installing the Software After downloading the software, double-click to install it. Click the **Download** button to install the software. Once the installation is complete, you will see the blue software icon on your desktop. ## Logging Into the Software 1. Double-click the software icon to open it. 2. Click the **black login button**. 3. On the jumping login page, click the **Chinese user login button**. 4. Since you have already logged in to the Chinese official website, you can directly click to log in as shown in the video. 5. If you need to re-login, simply enter your email address and password. ## Enjoy Your Design Journey! Thank you for following this tutorial. Now you can enjoy your design journey with CLO 3D!
